sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM negative: caller without the explicit sam_inbound role fails the AuthZ check (403)
sys_atf_test.description: hasRoleExactly('x_fed_day2_ops.sam_inbound') must be false for a caller who was not explicitly granted the role, even one holding admin — hasRole() would wrongly pass such a caller.

sys_atf_step.description: Impersonate day2.requester — an ordinary operator, not the IIQ integration user, and not granted x_fed_day2_ops.sam_inbound.
Assert the impersonated user fails the exact predicate clause 1 of sam_inbound_ritm.js enforces.

Impersonate day2.admin — carries the admin role but was NOT explicitly granted x_fed_day2_ops.sam_inbound. hasRoleExactly() must still refuse; a plain hasRole()/gs.hasRole() check would wrongly pass this user (the bug the P0-7 remediation closed).
Assert admin alone does not satisfy the explicit-grant check.
